HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.label: shit hole
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.promotedText: The colony is officially a shit hole. It's a start.
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.demotedText: The colony has sunk back to being a shit hole. The goblins don't seem to mind.

HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.label: mucky pit
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.promotedText: Enough goblins now squelch about that the colony counts as a mucky pit.
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.demotedText: Too few goblins remain to keep the muck properly stirred. The colony is a mucky pit again.

HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.label: shed
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.promotedText: The goblins have upgraded to a shed. Someone has put up a sign. It is spelt wrong.
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.demotedText: The goblins have shrunk back to shed numbers. The sign has fallen off.

HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.label: hovel
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.promotedText: The colony is now a proper hovel. Visitors are advised to hold their noses.
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.demotedText: The colony has slipped back to a hovel. The smell remains.

HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.label: warren
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.promotedText: Tunnels, nooks and goblins everywhere. The colony is now a warren.
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.demotedText: Half the tunnels stand empty. The colony is a warren once more.

HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.label: den
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.promotedText: The goblin den grows loud and crowded. Neighbours are getting nervous.
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.demotedText: The den is quieter than it was. The colony has fallen back to a den.

HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.label: burrow-town
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.promotedText: A hundred goblins! The colony is now a burrow-town, with its own (terrible) traditions.
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.demotedText: The burrow-town has thinned out. It's a burrow-town again, if only just.

HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.label: goblin stronghold
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.promotedText: The goblins have built a stronghold. The world is starting to take notice.
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.demotedText: The stronghold has lost goblins. It holds, but only just.

HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.label: goblin city
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.promotedText: A goblin city rises from the muck. The final goal is within reach.
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.demotedText: The goblin city has emptied a little. It's still a city, but the kingdom slips away.

HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.label: goblin kingdom
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.promotedText: Three hundred goblins! The colony is now a true goblin kingdom.
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.demotedText: The goblin kingdom is still a kingdom.
